claims.text: The Ritz opened in 1906 and was conceived by the hotelier Cesar Ritz.

findings.quote: When The Ritz opened its doors in 1906
Conceived by the famous hotelier César Ritz

claims.text: The hotel sits between Piccadilly and Green Park.

findings.quote: Situated between the bustling Piccadilly and the calm oasis of the stunning Royal Green Park

claims.text: Trafalgar Square, Buckingham Palace, the West End theatres and Bond Street are close to the hotel.

findings.quote: Find Trafalgar Square, Buckingham Palace, West End Theatres, Bond Street, and so much more on our doorstep.

claims.text: The Ritz Restaurant sits beneath a soaring glass roof, and its Executive Chef is John Williams MBE.

findings.quote: set within an elegant venue beneath a soaring glass roof
The Ritz Restaurant’s Executive Chef, John Williams MBE

claims.text: The Ritz Restaurant was named Restaurant of the Year at the National Restaurant Awards 2025.

findings.quote: The Ritz Restaurant has been awarded the prestigious title of Restaurant of the Year by The National Restaurant Awards 2025.

claims.text: Every Friday and Saturday, Live at The Ritz pairs dinner in The Ritz Restaurant with live music and dancing.

findings.quote: Every Friday and Saturday, “Live at The Ritz” transforms dinner into an evening of fine dining, live music, and dancing.

claims.text: Afternoon Tea includes freshly baked scones with Cornish clotted cream and strawberry preserve, and service is continuous, with courses replenished throughout the visit.

findings.quote: freshly baked scones with Cornish clotted cream and strawberry preserve
Service is continuous, with courses replenished throughout your visit.

claims.text: Afternoon Tea is accompanied by a musical ensemble in the 18th-century William Kent House.

findings.quote: An elegant musical ensemble accompanies your service, completing the Afternoon Tea experience within the stunning 18th-century William Kent House.

claims.text: The Secret Garden is an outdoor dining and drinking space within the hotel, planted with irises, hellebores, hydrangeas, crab-apple trees and white wisteria.

findings.quote: The Secret Garden, an enchanting outdoor dining and drinking destination in Mayfair, is a hidden oasis set within The Ritz London.
featuring irises, hellebores, hydrangeas, crab-apple trees and white wisteria

claims.text: Grand Deluxe Rooms have marble bathrooms with a deep soaking bathtub, rainfall shower, double vanity and heated marble floors.

findings.quote: Spacious marble bathroom with deep soaking bathtub, rainfall shower, double vanity, and heated marble floors

claims.text: The Royal Suite spans two floors, with views of Green Park and The Secret Garden through floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: spanning 204 square metres (2,195 sq ft) over two floors, offers views of Green Park and The Secret Garden through floor-to-ceiling windows

claims.text: The kidz@theritz package provides game consoles for older children, age-appropriate books and DVDs, and a complimentary Ritz teddy for younger children.

findings.quote: We provide game consoles in your rooms for older children, a selection of age-appropriate books and DVDs, and a complimentary Ritz teddy for younger children to cuddle.
kidz@theritz package

claims.text: The Rivoli Bar has a red and green marble chequerboard floor inspired by William Kent, under restored vaulted ceilings with hand-painted gold motifs.

findings.quote: centred around a striking red and green marble chequerboard floor inspired by William Kent
Restored historic vaulted ceilings, enhanced with hand-painted gold motifs

claims.text: The hotel's Tea Master, Giandomenico Scanu, travels to tea plantations worldwide to source its loose-leaf teas.

findings.quote: The Ritz London is home to the UK’s only certified Tea Master, Giandomenico Scanu. He travels to tea plantations worldwide to source our loose-leaf teas

claims.text: The hotel's 8th-generation Rolls-Royce Phantom EWB was hand-built in England and custom-made to match the hotel's design, and resident guests can hire it.

findings.quote: Our iconic 8th-generation Ritz Rolls-Royce Phantom EWB was hand-built in England and custom-made to match our hotel’s design.
The car is also available for hire as an exclusive service for resident guests

claims.text: The Secret Garden was created by Marcus Barnett Studios, with cashmere throws by Johnston's of Elgin as the evening cools.

findings.quote: Created by Marcus Barnett Studios
As temperatures cool into the evening, bespoke cashmere throws by Johnston’s of Elgin invite guests to linger a little longer in comfort.

claims.text: Afternoon Tea ends with seasonal cakes served tableside from the gueridon trolley.

findings.quote: Our cakes are the finale to your Afternoon Tea. Served tableside from the guéridon trolley, they change seasonally

claims.text: Gentlemen must wear a jacket and tie for Afternoon Tea and for lunch and dinner in The Ritz Restaurant; smart casual is fine at breakfast, The Rivoli Bar, The Secret Garden and The Cigar Shop, and sportswear is not permitted in any restaurant or bar.

findings.quote: Gentlemen are required to wear a jacket and tie (jeans and sportswear are not permitted for either ladies or gentlemen) for Afternoon Tea and for lunch and dinner in The Ritz Restaurant.
In all other areas of the hotel (The Ritz breakfast service, The Rivoli Bar, The Secret Garden, and The Cigar Shop), smart casual attire is acceptable.
Please note that sportswear is not permitted in any of the hotel’s restaurants or bars.

claims.text: An extra entertainment charge applies to the a la carte and Epicurean menus when live entertainment runs on Friday and Saturday evenings.

findings.quote: Live entertainment is provided on Friday and Saturday evenings. If you choose the à la carte or Epicurean menus, there is an additional entertainment charge of £58 per person.

claims.text: The Secret Garden opens weather permitting.

findings.quote: Opening times _(weather permitting)_
